reads_against.argmap: How do pure parāmarśas relate to vidyā/vidyeśvara? → Purity-condition = para-apara-form in śuddha-vidyā; contraction of māyā-onmeṣa is what splits them into vidyā/vidyeśvara.
c1_essence: Pure contemplations stand in pure knowledge as para-apara, contracting māyā's awakening into knower/known natures.
